description: Source code for a QuickBooks data migration utility within an ERPNext integration, including functions for OAuth token management, data fetching, processing, and saving various QuickBooks entities into ERPNext.

classes.name: QuickBooksMigrator
classes.description: Main class handling OAuth, data fetching, processing, and saving QuickBooks data into ERPNext.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Webhook callback to handle OAuth redirect, fetch tokens, and initiate migration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing OAuth session and setting up default values.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Updates default cost center and warehouse based on selected company.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Enqueues the migration process to run asynchronously.

methods.name: _migrate
methods.description: Performs the full migration process, including account setup, ledger fetching, fiscal year creation, and entity data migration.

methods.name: get_tokens
methods.description: Fetches OAuth tokens from QuickBooks API.

methods.name: _refresh_tokens
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth tokens when expired.

methods.name: _make_custom_fields
methods.description: Creates custom fields in ERPNext for QuickBooks IDs and company linkage.

methods.name: _make_custom_quickbooks_id_field
methods.description: Creates a custom field for QuickBooks ID in specified doctype.

methods.name: _make_custom_company_field
methods.description: Creates a custom field for company linkage in specified doctype.

methods.name: _migrate_accounts
methods.description: Creates root accounts and migrates account, tax rate, and tax code data.

methods.name: _make_root_accounts
methods.description: Creates standard root accounts like Asset, Equity, Expense, Liability, Income.

methods.name: _migrate_entries
methods.description: Fetches and processes entities from QuickBooks API and saves them into ERPNext.

methods.name: _fetch_general_ledger
methods.description: Fetches general ledger report from QuickBooks and processes entries.

methods.name: _create_fiscal_years
methods.description: Creates missing fiscal years based on ledger data.

methods.name: _migrate_entries_from_gl
methods.description: Migrates specific entities from general ledger data.

methods.name: _save_entries
methods.description: Saves a list of entities into ERPNext, calling specific save methods.

methods.name: _preprocess_entries
methods.description: Preprocesses entity data before saving.

methods.name: _get_gl_entries_from_section
methods.description: Parses sections of the general ledger report into entries.

methods.name: _preprocess_accounts
methods.description: Prepares account data for ERPNext, including hierarchy and grouping.

methods.name: _save_account
methods.description: Creates or updates an Account in ERPNext based on QuickBooks data.

methods.name: _get_account_type
methods.description: Determines ERPNext account type from QuickBooks account data.

methods.name: _preprocess_tax_rates
methods.description: Prepares tax rate data for ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_tax_rate
methods.description: Creates a Tax Rate account in ERPNext.

methods.name: _preprocess_tax_codes
methods.description: Prepares tax code data for ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_tax_code
methods.description: Placeholder for saving tax code data (not implemented).

methods.name: _save_customer
methods.description: Creates Customer record in ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_item
methods.description: Creates Item record in ERPNext.

methods.name: _allow_fraction_in_unit
methods.description: Sets UOM to allow fractional quantities.

methods.name: _save_vendor
methods.description: Creates Supplier record in ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_preference
methods.description: Saves user preferences, such as default shipping account.

methods.name: _save_invoice
methods.description: Creates Sales Invoice in ERPNext.

methods.name: _get_si_items
methods.description: Generates invoice items for ERPNext from QuickBooks invoice data.

methods.name: _get_item_taxes
methods.description: Calculates item taxes based on tax code.

methods.name: _get_invoice_payments
methods.description: Generates payment entries for invoices.

methods.name: _get_discount
methods.description: Extracts discount information from invoice lines.

methods.name: _save_invoice_as_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a Journal Entry in ERPNext for invoices saved as journal entries.

methods.name: _save_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a Journal Entry in ERPNext.

methods.name: __save_journal_entry
methods.description: Internal method to save and submit a Journal Entry.

methods.name: _save_bill
methods.description: Creates Purchase Invoice in ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_vendor_credit
methods.description: Creates Purchase Invoice for vendor credits.

methods.name: __save_purchase_invoice
methods.description: Internal method to create and submit a Purchase Invoice.

methods.name: _get_pi_items
methods.description: Generates purchase invoice items from QuickBooks data.

methods.name: _save_payment
methods.description: Creates payment journal entries in ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_bill_payment
methods.description: Creates journal entries for bill payments.

methods.name: _save_purchase
methods.description: Creates Purchase Invoice in ERPNext.

methods.name: _save_deposit
methods.description: Creates deposit journal entries.

methods.name: _save_advance_payment
methods.description: Creates journal entry for advance payments.

methods.name: _save_tax_payment
methods.description: Creates journal entry for tax payments.

methods.name: _save_inventory_qty_adjust
methods.description: Creates journal entry for inventory quantity adjustments.

methods.name: __save_ledger_entry_as_je
methods.description: Internal method to save ledger entries as journal entries.

methods.name: _get_taxes
methods.description: Calculates taxes for an entry.

methods.name: _get_tax_type
methods.description: Determines tax type for a tax rate.

methods.name: _get_parent_tax_rate
methods.description: Finds parent tax rate for nested taxes.

methods.name: _get_parent_row_id
methods.description: Finds index of parent tax in tax list.

methods.name: _create_address
methods.description: Creates address record linked to entity.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Performs GET request with OAuth token, refreshes if expired.

methods.name: _get_account_name_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves ERPNext account name from quickbooks_id.

methods.name: _publish
methods.description: Publishes real-time progress updates.

methods.name: _get_unique_account_name
methods.description: Generates a unique account name to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: _log_error
methods.description: Logs errors with detailed traceback.

methods.name: set_indicator
methods.description: Updates migration status indicator.
